sources.title: image_classification_with_vision_transformer - Colab
sources.snippet: This example implements the Vision Transformer (ViT) model by Alexey Dosovitskiy et al. for image classification, and demonstrates it on the CIFAR-100 dataset. The ViT model applies the Transformer architecture with self-attention to sequences of image patches, without using convolution layers.
